description: `is a <type-word>` with a word that is not a recognized Core type raises `ol-unknown-type` naming the word (spec/execution-model.md:146-166, error-model.md `ol-unknown-type`). Raised at stage=semantic, mirroring the checker's own stage=semantic copy of this rule since `execute()` runs `parse()` only, not `check()` (issues #94/#104/#114 convention). Execution halts, so only the `instruction` event is kept. Issue #99. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
